name: Stormy Potential

angles.text: Using thunder lizard organs to power dormant devices shows goblin ingenuity, though the safety margins are nearly nonexistent.
Rezlak's work supports the Horde's foothold and travel through Durotar, where marauding harpies from Drygulch Ravine threaten travelers and supply caravans.

faq.answer: Rezlak, a goblin merchant and tinkerer near Drygulch Ravine in Durotar, asks for your help. Gazlowe, Ratchet's chief engineer, taught him to seize opportunity, and Rezlak hopes to restore a drained orb with the charge in local beasts' electrical organs.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Stormy Potential?

faq.answer: Rezlak hopes to charge an intact orb that has lost all its power. He plans to use thunder lizard organs to defend his caravan from harpies harassing the area.
faq.q: What is Rezlak trying to charge with the organs?

faq.answer: Thunder lizards live in a gorge west of Rezlak's position near Drygulch Ravine in Durotar. You can bring their electrical organs back to him.
faq.q: Where are the thunder lizards found?

faq.answer: Thunder lizards are dangerous because they release bolts of lightning. Their electrical blasts can teach travelers a painful lesson they may get only once.
faq.q: Why are thunder lizards dangerous to harvest?

faq.answer: Harpies from Drygulch Ravine ambushed Rezlak's caravan. He hopes the charged orb will deter them or serve as a weapon against further attacks on his shipments.
faq.q: Why does Rezlak fear the harpies?

faq.answer: Rezlak looks to Gazlowe, Ratchet's chief engineer, as a mentor and business inspiration. Gazlowe's advice to seize opportunity guides Rezlak's plan for the orb.
faq.q: What is Rezlak's connection to Gazlowe?

sections.body: Near Drygulch Ravine in Durotar, harpies threaten Rezlak's caravan, and a sound magical orb has lost its power. Gazlowe, Ratchet's chief engineer, once advised Rezlak to seize opportunity when it knocks. Now the goblin plans to charge the dormant orb and answer both troubles at once.
sections.title: Seizing Opportunity

sections.body: Rezlak needs strong electricity to restore his drained orb. Thunder lizards live in the gorge west of Drygulch Ravine, and their organs generate and conduct deadly lightning. He asks you to bring him those charged organs. Rezlak hopes to channel their volatile current into the orb and defend his supply wagons from harpy ambushes.
sections.title: Harnessing the Storm

summary: Near Drygulch Ravine, Rezlak looks for a way to protect his caravan from harpies. He hopes to charge a drained orb with the electrical organs of Durotar's thunder lizards.
